title: 第1204章 先化形还是先分身第1203章 换一种联系
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: 敖青看着郑常手里的奇怪吊坠，并没有感受到什么，但最奇怪的就是没感觉到什么了。
能让双方不能对对方产生杀意，是很强大的法器。
就算只是产生杀意会有反噬，也是不弱了。
这么强的法器，为什么看起来和凡物似的？
“这玩意真的有用？”
“你试试不就知道了，反正就要点血。”
“行吧。”
【对的，你们快相互帮对方割破手掌，然后伤口相对握住血……】
没等系统说完郑常就随意逼出一滴血来，塞到了吊坠中间的空心宝石里。
“你也滴一滴血进去就行。”
郑常压根没理会系统的建议。
这娘们最近肯定是看了什么男上加男的书，变得有点腐，不用理她。
敖青听了郑常的话，照着对方的样子逼出一滴精血，送到了吊坠里。
两滴血在中空的宝石中融合，透明的宝石变成了血红色。
看起来像是产生了效果。
果然，系统说的那些给里给气的仪式都是多余的。
“这就行了？”
敖青有点不相信。
“信不信的，我试着弄死你看看不就知道了？”
郑常道。
“不是？凭什么啊？不是双向的吗？就不能是我试着弄死你？”
敖青反驳道。
“也行，让另一个你来吧，你估计提不起弄死我的心。”
“啊？不是，你怎么知道我和他和解了？”
“因为我又不傻，认识几十年了，我还能不了解你？怎么会连你精神分裂我都看不出来？日后你被人夺舍了我都能立刻认出来。”
“那你还装不知道？好家伙，你看我每天瞒着你，把我当猴耍是吧？”
“唉，那真是没有，我从不耍猴的，奈何猴耍自己。”
“你特么……好好好，试着弄死你是吧，不用他来，我来给你一下子。”
敖青咬牙切齿道。
敖青的气息变得狂暴起来，嘴上说着不用凶敖青来，要自己动手。
终究是稍微借用了以另一个自己的气息。
然而在这股狂暴的气息还没攀升到顶峰，敖青忽然感觉自己的灵力受到了阻滞，而且随着自己的杀意越浓，阻碍越强。
content_en:
Ao Qing looked at the strange pendant in Zheng Chang's hand and didn't feel anything, but the strangest thing was that he didn't feel anything at all.
It is a very powerful magic weapon that can prevent both parties from murdering each other.
Even if there is a backlash if there is just murderous intention, it is not weak.
Why does such a powerful magic weapon look like an ordinary object?
"Is this thing really useful?"
"You'll know if you try it. Anyway, you need to draw blood."
"Okay."
[Yes, you guys quickly cut each other's palms, and then hold the wounds against each other to hold the blood...]
Before the system could finish speaking, Zheng Chang randomly forced out a drop of blood and stuffed it into the hollow gem in the middle of the pendant.
"Just put a drop of blood in it."
Zheng Chang ignored the system's suggestions at all.
This bitch must have read some book about men on top of men recently, and she has become a bit rotten, so ignore her.
After listening to Zheng Chang's words, Ao Qing forced out a drop of blood and put it into the pendant.
The two drops of blood merged in the hollow gem, and the transparent gem turned blood red.
It looks like it's having an effect.
Sure enough, all the rituals mentioned by the system to inject energy are redundant.
"Is this enough?"
Ao Qing didn't believe it.
"Believe it or not, won't you know if I try to kill you?"
Zheng Chang said.
"No? Why? Isn't it a two-way street? Can't it be me trying to kill you?"
Ao Qing retorted.
"Okay, let the other one do it. You probably can't afford to kill me."
"Ah? No, how do you know that I have reconciled with him?"
"Because I'm not stupid. I've known you for decades, but I still don't understand you? How come I can't even tell that you're schizophrenic? I'll be able to recognize you immediately if you're snatched away in the future."
"Then you still pretend not to know? Good guy, you see I hide it from you every day and treat me like a monkey, right?"
"Oh, that's really not true. I never play tricks on monkeys, but monkeys play tricks on themselves."
"What the hell... I'm trying to kill you, right? He doesn't need to come, I'll do it for you."
Ao Qing gritted his teeth and said.
Ao Qing's breath became violent, and he said that there was no need to hurt Ao Qing, but to do it himself.
After all, he slightly borrowed the breath of another self.
However, before this violent aura reached its peak, Ao Qing suddenly felt that his spiritual power was blocked, and as his murderous intention grew stronger, the obstruction became stronger.
title_en: Chapter 1204: Transform first or clone first? Chapter 1203: Change a different kind of contact
